body.name: Residual-continuity-only box completion
body.construction: For \(g\in\mathcal B(P_{\mathrm{obs}})\), set \(f^g_{1,z}(r)=[g_z(r)-b_{1,z}(r)+b_{0,z}(r)]_+\) and \(f^g_{0,z}(r)=[-g_z(r)+b_{1,z}(r)-b_{0,z}(r)]_+\), and set \(q^g_{a,z}=f^g_{a,z}/u_{a,z}\) on \(\{u_{a,z}>0\}\) and zero on \(\{u_{a,z}=0\}\). Conditional on \(X=(z,r)\), draw \((\widetilde T_a,\Delta_a)\) independently across arms from \(P_{\mathrm{obs}}((\widetilde T,\Delta)\in\cdot\mid A=a,X=(z,r))\). If \(\Delta_a=0\), set \(T(a)=\widetilde T_a\) and \(C(a)=t_{\max}+1\). If \(\Delta_a=1\), set \(C(a)=\widetilde T_a\) and set \(T(a)=t_{\max}\) with probability \(q^g_{a,z}(r)\), otherwise \(T(a)=\widetilde T_a\). Draw \(A\) independently given \(X\) with the protocol-fixed probabilities \(\pi_a(X)\); the resulting law is \(P^g_{\mathrm{cont}}\).
